description: Provision a Google Cloud Alloydb AlloyDBBackup via Config Connector. Fields mirror the alloydb.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 AlloyDBBackup spec.

clusterNameRef.description: The full resource name of the backup source cluster (e.g., projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{clusterId}). Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed AlloyDBCluster resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/locations/{{location}}/clusters/{{clusterID}}".

name.description: The name of an AlloyDBCluster resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of an AlloyDBCluster resource.

description.description: Immutable. User-provided description of the backup.

encryptionConfig.description: EncryptionConfig describes the encryption config of a cluster or a backup that is encrypted with a CMEK (customer-managed encryption key).

kmsKeyName.description: Immutable. The fully-qualified resource name of the KMS key. Each Cloud KMS key is regionalized and has the following format: projects/[PROJECT]/locations/[REGION]/keyRings/[RING]/cryptoKeys/[KEY_NAME].

location.description: Immutable. The location where the alloydb backup should reside.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

projectRef.description: The project that this resource belongs to. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The backupId of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.

title: GCP Alloydb AlloyDBBackup
